640:t_1:86.en:
$$赤木$$
「So Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, Dr. $$トライア$$ and scientists all over the world worked out that technology and turned it into a power to save humanity.」

640:t_1:87.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It truly is the culmination of humanity's wisdom.」

640:t_1:88.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even against a great collapse that comes once every 120 million years, I'm sure we can overcome it if everyone on Earth joins forces.」

640:t_1:90.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What's wrong, $$シルヴィア$$? Is that number so big it's making your head spin?」

640:t_1:91.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「No, but... I just thought it was strange...」

640:t_1:93.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「A year is based on the time Earth takes to go around the sun once, right?」

640:t_1:94.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Why is that used to measure things on the scale of the whole universe?」

640:t_1:95.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Now that you mention it, you're right.」

640:t_1:96.en:
$$桂$$
「That's a real mystery of the universe.」

640:t_1:100.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Maybe I'll ask that bastard $$ゲペルニッチ$$ if we ever meet again.」

640:t_1:102.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems you're feeling something like a premonition.」

640:t_1:104.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So it's the existence of God...」

640:t_1:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Our contact with $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the ruins on $$神根島$$... And the fundamental calamity...」

640:t_1:106.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What always accompanies them is the existence of gods... higher-dimensional life-forms...」

640:t_1:107.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm sure we'll learn the truth about them in this battle.」

640:t_1:108.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I wonder what that will bring humanity as we enter a new era...」

640:t_1:112.en: ～$$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Interior Facilities～

640:t_1:115.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... How's everyone in Year 3, Class 4 at $$陣代高校$$ doing? It's me, $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

640:t_1:117.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We've caused you all a lot of trouble and worry, but we're managing somehow.」

640:t_1:118.en:
$$宗介$$
「Once this battle is over, I'll keep my promise to bring $$千鳥$$ home. Please wait for us until then.」

640:t_1:119.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$, the $$ボランティア部$$ and I want to graduate from $$陣代高校$$ with everyone from Year 2, Class 4. So we'll definitely be back by March.」

640:t_1:120.en:
$$宗介$$
「I imagine things are hard on Earth, too, but we're heading out.」

640:t_1:123.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I think your expressions are still a little stiff...」

640:t_1:124.en:
$$クラン$$
「Especially you, $$宗介$$! How many times do I have to tell you to smile!?」

640:t_1:125.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not an actor. I can't smile simply because someone tells me to.」

640:t_1:126.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd known this would be such a hassle, I'd have found a way to visit $$陣代高校$$...」

640:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「You say that, $$千鳥$$... but we've all been busy with our own work this past month. We simply didn't have the time.」

640:t_1:128.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Especially you, $n. You and the other $$リアクター$$s were helping Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others with their research the whole time.」

640:t_1:129.en:
$n
「So sending a video letter instead was a good idea, but I never imagined we'd have this much trouble...」

640:t_1:130.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... This is getting so tiresome. Why don't you just put on that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ suit?」

640:t_1:131.en:
$$宗介$$
「Good idea. That should satisfy Captain $$クラン$$, too.」

640:t_1:132.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, you actually brought that thing aboard!?」

640:t_1:133.en:
$$宗介$$
「I judged that it could provide sufficient combat capability in the battles ahead.」

640:t_1:134.en:
$n
「So that's why Lieutenant $$サックス$$ and $$アル$$ were arguing in the hangar yesterday...」

640:t_1:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That tactic $$アル$$ suggested, catching the enemy off guard... I wonder just how effective it would be.」

640:t_1:136.en:
$$宗介$$
「With respect, Miss $$スズネ$$, I've spent most of this month modifying it.」

640:t_1:137.en:
$$宗介$$
「Unfortunately, I only completed one prototype, but using $$ルカ$$'s RVF-25 as a model, I've perfected coordinated attacks with unmanned wingmen, which...」

640:t_1:138.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you'd skipped all that pointless work, you'd have had plenty of time to go to $$陣代高校$$...!」

640:t_1:139.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$! We should strive for lasting peace through mutual understanding...」

640:t_1:140.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't think I'll ever understand you!」

640:t_1:141.en:
$$クラン$$
「OK! We got a great shot!」

640:t_1:143.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes, yes! You're much better when you're being yourselves!」

640:t_1:144.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Th-then what was the point of all our hard work through take 27...?」

640:t_1:147.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$! You haven't forgotten your promise to treat me to galactic ramen, have you!?」

640:t_1:148.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$風間$$! I got that first issue of 'Manly Super Robots Monthly' you wanted! You've got something to look forward to!」

640:t_1:149.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$! Are you working hard on your entrance exam prep!?」

640:t_1:150.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll be there for graduation, too! Let's all go to karaoke again!」

640:t_1:152.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But don't treat us like your odd-job service the second we show up!」

640:t_1:153.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We do things besides picking up trash, you know.」

640:t_1:154.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$大貫$$, I'm sorry I haven't kept in touch. Hire me again when I get back!」

640:t_1:155.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Is everyone doing well? It's $$西条涼音$$, your former student teacher.」

640:t_1:156.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n and I are doing well, too! I'm... $n and I are both looking forward to seeing everyone again!」

640:t_1:157.en:
$n
「H-hold on, Miss $$スズネ$$! You're making way too much of a point of that!」

640:t_1:158.en:
$$ボス$$
「Hahaha! Too bad, boys, myself included!」

640:t_1:159.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Apparently those two got together somewhere along the way!」

640:t_1:163.en:
$n
「Hey! What are you saying, Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

640:t_1:164.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The cool, wild, mysterious $n you all knew is dead!」

640:t_1:165.en:
$$宗介$$
「What we've got here is an idiot who got a girlfriend even though he can't read the room!」

640:t_1:168.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The power of love is infinite, after all.」

kept_omissions: 640:t_1:89: Sylvia repeats the 120-million-year figure pensively before questioning why Earth years measure cosmic events.
640:t_1:98: Sivil's deliberately broken speech preserves her established halting voice; this is stylistic, not unresolved Japanese pro-drop.
640:t_1:101: Source is deliberate silence; no words or inferred thought are supplied.
640:t_1:105: Chirico lists contact with Wiseman, Kamine Island ruins and the fundamental calamity; Zero provides their shared connection next.
640:t_1:137: Sousuke's technical explanation of the drone attack is interrupted by Kaname's complaint in t_1:138.
640:t_1:139: Sousuke starts an appeal for peace through understanding; Kaname interrupts in t_1:140.
640:t_1:161: Hibiki starts a reproach to Boss, Nuke and Mucha, then Suzune interrupts with her question.
uncertain: 640:t_1:115/119: The source greets Year 3 Class 4 but later says Year 2 Class 4. Both source year numbers are deliberately retained; no continuity repair invented.
640:t_1:137: RVF-25 is the abbreviated machine identifier in the source; kept as plain RVF-25, not expanded to a longer model.
